title: [GMCP 203.048.02] Production path: Independent GMCP qualification and continuously complete release gate
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-048-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: One hermetic qualification command reconstructs the requirements ledger, builds clean artifacts, runs unit/integration/conformance/extension/interop/security/fuzz/platform/performance/recovery/doc tests, verifies evidence provenance, and emits a signed human-readable scorecard. Release is allowed only with 100% applicable requirements traced and passing, zero unexplained compatibility gaps, zero unresolved critical/high security findings and every VC-203 mastery gate green; new standards or accepted metrics automatically reopen qualification until classified. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
